audit_status.source_base: Greek 2 Corinthians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for opening, God of all comfort, affliction/pressure, death sentence in Asia, prayer help, sincerity, changed travel plans, Yes in Messiah, Spirit seal/pledge.

verses.restored: Paul, apostle of Messiah Jesus through the will of the Divine, and Timothy the sibling, to the assembly of the Divine that is in Corinth, with all the holy ones who are in all Achaia:

familiar.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

verses.restored: Grace to you and peace from Divine our Father and Lord Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.restored: Blessed is the Divine and Father of our Lord Jesus Messiah, the Father of compassions and Divine of all comfort/encouragement,

familiar.text: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

verses.restored: the One comforting/encouraging us in all our pressure, so that we may be able to comfort/encourage those in every pressure through the comfort/encouragement with which we ourselves are comforted/encouraged by the Divine.

familiar.text: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

verses.restored: Because just as the sufferings of Messiah abound into us, so through Messiah also our comfort/encouragement abounds.

familiar.text: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.

verses.restored: But whether we are pressured, it is for your comfort/encouragement and salvation/healing; whether we are comforted/encouraged, it is for your comfort/encouragement, working in endurance of the same sufferings that we also suffer.

familiar.text: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.

verses.restored: And our hope for you is firm, knowing that as you are sharers of the sufferings, so also of the comfort/encouragement.

familiar.text: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.

verses.restored: For we do not want you to be unaware, siblings, concerning our pressure that happened in Asia, that we were weighed down beyond measure, beyond strength, so that we despaired even of living.

familiar.text: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:

verses.restored: But we ourselves have had the sentence of death in ourselves, so that we would not trust upon ourselves but upon the Divine who raises the dead.

familiar.text: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:

verses.restored: Who rescued us from so great a death and will rescue, in whom we have hoped that he will still rescue,

familiar.text: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;

verses.restored: you also helping together by prayer for us, so that from many faces thanks may be given on our behalf for the grace-gift given to us through many.

familiar.text: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

verses.restored: For our boasting is this: the witness of our conscience, that in simplicity/sincerity and purity of the Divine, not in fleshly wisdom but in grace of the Divine, we conducted ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

familiar.text: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.

verses.restored: For we write no other things to you than what you read or also understand; and I hope you will understand to the end,

familiar.text: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;

verses.restored: just as you also understood us in part, that we are your boast, as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

familiar.text: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.

verses.restored: And in this confidence I was intending to come to you first, so that you might have a second grace,

familiar.text: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;

verses.restored: and through you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you and by you to be sent forward to Judea.

familiar.text: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.

verses.restored: Therefore, intending this, did I then use lightness? Or what I plan, do I plan according to flesh, so that with me there should be Yes, yes and No, no?

familiar.text: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

verses.restored: But trustworthy is the Divine, that our word toward you is not Yes and No.

familiar.text: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.

verses.restored: For the Son of the Divine, Jesus Messiah, who was proclaimed among you through us, through me and Silvanus and Timothy, did not become Yes and No, but in him Yes has come to be.

familiar.text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.

verses.restored: For as many as are promises of the Divine, in him is the Yes; therefore also through him is the Amen to the Divine for glory through us.

familiar.text: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.

verses.restored: But the One confirming us with you into Messiah and anointing us is the Divine,

familiar.text: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;

verses.restored: who also sealed us and gave the pledge/down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

familiar.text: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

verses.restored: But I call the Divine as witness upon my soul/life, that to spare you I no longer came to Corinth.

familiar.text: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.

verses.restored: Not that we lord over your trust, but we are coworkers of your joy; for by trust you stand.

familiar.text: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.

translation_notes: Paraklesis and parakaleo are intentionally rendered comfort/encouragement to preserve the repeated word family.
Paul's leadership posture in 1:24 is non-domineering: not lording over trust, but coworkers of joy.
